task: Open /home/user/Documents/photo_base.png in GIMP, then add /home/user/Documents/texture_overlay.png as a new layer on top of it. Set the top (texture) layer's blend mode to Multiply and its opacity to 60%. Flatten the image and export the final composite as a PNG to /home/user/Documents/multiply_result.png. The output must be 512x512 pixels.

verification.description: Center pixel shows blend effect (not pure yellow/white from base) — R and G channels darkened by multiply
Center pixel blue channel still affected by multiply (not 255, not raw overlay either)

cli_feasibility.translation: Use ImageMagick: composite -compose multiply -gravity center overlay.png base.png -alpha set -channel A -evaluate set 60% output.png
cli_feasibility.reason: Blend modes exist in ImageMagick but syntax is complex and may require testing
